Visitor removes figure elements with their captions

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.htmltomarkdown.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        class _TestVisitor implements HtmlVisitor {
            @Override public VisitResult visitFigureStart(NodeContext ctx) {        return new VisitResult.Skip();    }
        }
        var visitor = new _TestVisitor();
        var result = HtmlToMarkdownRs.convert("<p>See the chart below:</p><figure><img src=\"chart.svg\"><figcaption>Revenue Trends 2020-2024</figcaption></figure><p>As shown in the chart above.</p>", ConversionOptions.builder().withVisitor(visitor).build());
        System.out.println(result);
    }
}
```
